title: SIP-CACHE-001 consumer registry (B3 Decision 1 — explicit governed registration)
notes: This artifact is the ONLY source of SIP consumer registrations. Nothing is seeded by discovery.
Every consumer that is allowed a profile MUST carry a positive symbol cap for it (B3 Decision 2).
The SIP_LIVE freshness bound is never stated here; freshness_policy_ref names the governed execution policy that supplies it (B3 Decision 3).
Ships EMPTY: Strategy 9's entry requires governed cap values and a frozen freshness policy, neither of which exists yet.
